about: Conquer enemy nests and lead your colony through the perils of the forest in this groundbreaking RTS. Empire of the Ants is a photorealistic, third-person real-time strategy game where you command your insect legions in epic battles.
A massive update for Empire of the Ants, focused on replayability, strategy, and co-op multiplayer!
Survive endless waves of ever-changing enemies. How long can you last?
summary: Conquer enemy nests and lead your colony in this groundbreaking RTS
